name: Diodes Incorporated
summary: Diodes Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, provides semiconductor products in Asia, the Americas, and Europe. The company offers MOSFET and SiC MOSFET discrete semiconductor products; data line protection, power line protection, thyrister, USB Type-C protection, and transient voltage suppressor protection devices; Schottky diodes, small signal switching diodes, Zener diodes, and SiC diodes; and bridges, super barrier rectifiers, Schottky rectifiers, Schottky bridge rectifiers, and fast and ultra-fast rectifiers.
